description: This Swift source file defines the ControlChannel class and related data structures for managing a control communication channel within an application. It includes handling of connection states, telemetry, events, error handling, and interaction with remote endpoints and notification handling.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the control communication channel, including establishing connections, handling states, sending and receiving events, and error management. Uses Swift Concurrency features for asynchronous operation and integrates with other system components.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the control channel in local mode, establishing endpoint communication.

methods.name: configure(mode:)
methods.description: Configures the control channel with the specified mode: local or remote, setting up necessary tunnels and connections.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Attempts to establish or refresh the connection to the control endpoint, updating the connection state accordingly.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects and shuts down the control channel, resetting internal state.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the control connection, returning response data or throwing an error.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the latest heartbeat event information.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the control endpoint with specified method and parameters, returning raw data.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Converts errors into user-readable messages, specifically handling gateway and URL errors.

methods.name: scheduleRecovery
methods.description: Schedules an automatic recovery attempt after a connection loss or failure.

methods.name: establishGatewayConnection
methods.description: Ensures the gateway connection is active and healthy before proceeding.

methods.name: refreshAuthSourceLabel
methods.description: Refreshes the label indicating the source of authentication.

methods.name: formatAuthSource
methods.description: Formats the description of the authentication source based on type.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message through the control channel.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Starts listening to incoming push events from the gateway.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway push messages, routing to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: routeWorkActivity
methods.description: Processes agent events to update work activity based on stream type.

methods.name: bridgeToProtocolArgs
methods.description: Converts a value of type AnyCodable to a dictionary suitable for protocol arguments.
